authorization: Latest user request: Try making some of them hit the memetic identity standard. One bounded Symbols experiment; no wider campaign dispatch.
reading_hypothesis: Expose the hit/miss and append/commit transitions as one recognizable ownership-preserving grammar. Currently three result-unpacking helpers separate an existing ID from the old-length ID and conceal the condition under which the forward map is extended. Prefer visible symmetry between returning an existing ID and committing exactly one new ID, with unchanged-state exhaustion. Remove conceptual plumbing only where this makes the state transition inspectable; avoid labels or wrappers without a semantic role.
preference_provenance: Author hypothesis before candidate generation and scoring; user requested the objective but did not approve a notation.
constraints: Preserve seven public operations and all types, imports, dependency pins and unsupported-constructor boundary.
Only the four selected intern-family definitions may change; at most two replacement helpers.
Preserve original model, observations, assertions and all eight laws. Mutation text locators may be re-anchored without changing their semantic fault or asserting case.
One substantive generation; at most one compiler-diagnostic retry. Retain first source and first compiler result.
Run full proof and native/JS conformance/release, eight mutations and native performance comparisons.
Review every changed or introduced declaration on all three unchanged axes; no unchanged score retry.
No publication, rubric change or shared campaign-state edit.
